say:1:1620860001:1.text: Alright, you can leave me here. I know the rest of the way.

narration:3:1620860003:1.text: Contess disappears into the Stellar Spire.

say:7:1620860005:1.source_cn: 看来大家已经到齐了。嗯……康缇丝不在这里吗？

say:9:1620860006:1.text: Playing a game in Merlin's tower... I'm never going to forget this!

say:9:1620860006:1.female: Playing a game in Merlin's tower... I'm never going to forget this!

say:10:1620860007:1.text: I can't wait to see what lies ahead on this adventure...
say:10:1620860007:1.source_cn: 好期待啊！不知道这次我们又能演绎一个怎样的故事……
